title: Exam FRQ: the recording studio
prompt:
45-minute FRQ. Implement the `Studio` class (three mechanisms):

- constructor takes the hourly rate (int cents)
- `book(String band)` adds the band's name to the booking list if not already booked (returns true; false when already present — no duplicates)
- `bill(String band, int hours)` returns rate * hours for a BOOKED band, or 0 for an unbooked one
- `roster()` returns the number of booked bands (no duplicates counted)
- `endMonth()` returns the total billed across all bill() calls and resets the billing total (bookings persist)

Implement the class.

tests.name: studio frq
tests.hint: Three mechanisms: a guarded list insert (contains check), a membership-gated charge, and a read-and-reset total.
